environment.sensor_placement: Fixed rigid mount; position, height, azimuth, elevation, target-zone polygon, and sensor serial must be declared per slot before capture.
environment.target_zone: A predeclared bounded three-dimensional zone covering the sensor observation target; it must remain empty for the entire candidate context and target interval.
allowed: documented sensor health check before and after each slot
forbidden: human or animal in target zone or observation cone
moving fan or periodic mechanical source

authoritative_evidence.no_human_target: A continuous, time-synchronized, authorized target-zone occupancy reference covering the complete recording, with immutable evidence hash and independent review.
authoritative_evidence.no_target_physiological_source: The same target-zone occupancy reference plus a sealed-zone/access record proving no human, animal, respiration simulator, or other physiological source is present.
authoritative_evidence.valid_sensor_observation: Immutable sensor-health telemetry and raw-stream continuity evidence, validated under the governing quality contract. Operator statement is supporting evidence only unless it is the explicitly authorized occupancy reference.

capture_protocol.health_check: Pre- and post-slot health checks are recorded outside candidate-window selection; any failure rejects the slot.

stop_conditions: Stop successfully when all nine fixed slots have captured valid evidence and are ready for later authorized deterministic scanning.
Stop a slot immediately on any presence, physiological-source, sensor-validity, timestamp, or provenance failure; retain a rejection record.
Stop the campaign when any fixed slot fails; do not replace, top up, reallocate, adjust quota, or start a second attempt.
If an authorized occupancy reference cannot cover the target zone, classify the source as DATA_SOURCE_INVALID_FOR_M_PV3_8 and do not capture for this purpose.
